desc: 高密度尼龙面料防泼水耐磨，多分区收纳，S型减压背负，旅行通勤双色双肩包
leaf: 高密度尼龙多功能旅行双肩包
name: 高密尼龙减压旅行双肩包款

shots.intent: 深色虚化幕墙上以白色大字立住「多功能旅行双肩包」的第一主张，三秒内赢得停留与点击。
shots.textZone: top block: oversized bold white headline, one white subtitle line, and one small letter-spaced white kicker line

shots.intent: 以全宽红幅承接首屏情绪，再用四枚六边形图标带快速给出品类承诺，降低浏览戒心。
shots.textZone: centered white bold headline plus small subline inside the red band; four evenly spaced hexagon icon groups with two-line labels across the grey band

shots.intent: 用侧视尺寸标注线与规格清单回答「多大、多重、什么材质」，消除尺码疑虑。
shots.textZone: black bar with white section label 「{callout_1}」; dimension lines with three value labels; right side a minimal spec list of four generic field rows with short sample values

shots.intent: 满版织物微距叠加蓝色数据面板制造性能冲击，再用四枚图标钉死防泼水耐磨不褪色透气的面料卖点。
shots.textZone: centered steel blue overlay panel with two stat blocks; below on white a steel blue headline row with arrow glyphs and four hexagon icon labels

shots.intent: 正上方俯视打开的主仓，用蓝色浮层面板讲清高发泡防震垫与电脑隔层，坐实护机能力。
shots.textZone: steel blue translucent overlay panel on one side with a spaced white label line and two white copy lines

shots.intent: 正面整机居中、六枚圆形微距环绕并用红色虚线牵引，一次性证明提手拉链扣具面料的做工。
shots.textZone: one red pill label plus one short grey support line beside each circular crop

shots.intent: 同机位同光并列双色款型并压一条红幅过渡语，让买家快速锁定配色并自然翻页。
shots.textZone: one short white label on the red transition band; one short label under each colorway

shots.intent: 红幅章节条点出「多功能大容量」主题，棚角灰调空间让产品以干净立体的方式完成场景代入。
shots.textZone: inside the red band: a white numbered circle, a bold white headline and one small white subline

shots.intent: 侧视微开袋状态配合红色虚线标注逐层讲清主层副层小隔层与调节扣，消除装不下找不到的疑虑。
shots.textZone: five short crimson labels with one-line grey supports placed around the product, connected by thin dashed crimson leader lines

shots.intent: 背面视角加气流箭头、圆形微距与三层垫爆炸图，证明 S 型肩带与透气背垫的减负逻辑。
shots.textZone: red band with white numbered circle, headline and subline; one label beside the circular crop; diagram band with short layer labels

shots.intent: 正面侧面背面三视角等比陈列并配细框标签条，让买家完成对产品外形的最终确认。
shots.textZone: one thin-bordered label box with a short title and a small grey subcaption line under each view

shots.intent: 低角度气势收尾，红幅内实色行动按钮直接承接下单动作，不编造任何优惠与会员信息。
shots.textZone: bold headline above the product; inside the red band a white subline and a solid rounded button

style.backgroundSystem: alternating full-width flat bands: pure white #FFFFFF sections, light grey #F0F0F0 icon strips, full-bleed crimson #C9162E chapter bands, deep black #111111 section-title bars, one full-bleed deep charcoal #2B2B2B fabric-texture feature band, and a light grey studio-corner backdrop (wall #E8E8E8 meeting floor #D9D9D9) for the scene shot
style.iconSystem: thin-line hexagon outline icons with dark grey stroke, red pill-shaped labels, thin dashed red leader lines, and white numbered circles on red chapter bands
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light on product shots, soft front key with soft contact shadows, neutral color temperature; flat even lighting with no photographic shadows on pure graphic bands; gentle rim separation on the dark opening hero only
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent band-driven ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF sections, light grey #F0F0F0 bands, near-black #1A1A1A headline text, crimson red #C9162E full-width chapter bands with white bold headlines, steel blue #2E75B6 overlay data panels, and a deep charcoal #2B2B2B fabric-texture feature band; neutral color temperature; bold modern geometric sans-serif CJK-safe headlines, white on red and dark bands and near-black on light bands; consistent thin-line hexagon outline icons with dark grey stroke, red pill labels, thin dashed red leader lines, and white numbered circles on red bands; bright even high-key studio lighting on product shots with soft contact shadows and flat even lighting on graphic bands; product centered and upright with a stable front 3/4 hero angle reused across variant and closing shots; clean margins inside every band; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand logos, no QR codes.
noDrift: no brand logos, watermarks or QR codes
style.presentationRules: product centered and upright, stable front 3/4 hero angle reused across variant and closing shots; colorways hex-pinned at generation time; callouts always via red pills, dashed leader lines or hexagon icon rows; data stats shown inside steel blue overlay panels
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep and flat band backgrounds plus a matte light-grey studio corner; no reflective or textured tabletops
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif (CJK-safe); white headlines on red and dark bands, near-black on light bands; steel blue #2E75B6 reserved for overlay data-panel headings; thin-bordered label boxes with a small grey subcaption line; short labels only, no dense body text
